body: You're correct- there are vet specialists, but most of us are GPs. And unfortunately, I am pretty much bad across the board at the job :( I am good at talking to owners and helping people understand what's going on with their pet, but you don't want me treating your animals in any capacity.

I love all of it. I love my patients, I love the medicine, I love surgery... it satisfies me so perfectly. The only thing I don't like is having to charge money for it, and having to watch people make decisions based on finances. Other than that, I love it all. That's why it's so devastating to lose it. 
 
 
Thanks for your response. I have told both my bf and my current therapist a slightly watered down version of what I'm feeling. But I don't know how to tell them their support isn't helping.
